resolved_calibration_config.action_space.normalization: per-position residual RMS at the writable boundary

A1_READABLE.construction: existing accepted leakage-clean locus-native L3_24 readable process-quality direction, carried byte-for-byte and unit RMS

A2_WRITABLE.construction: existing accepted leading direction of the centered exact-protocol S1/S3 L3_24 injection-delta bundle; reconstruction explicitly distinguished from the missing historical tensor
A2_WRITABLE.historical_tensor_status: MISSING; reconstructed from hash-verified exact-protocol bundle

A3_CAUSAL_MEAN.construction: unitRMS(raw arithmetic mean of the exact [8,2048] causal-adapter-induced L3_24 update matrix in the frozen reference order)

A4_SEQUENCE_MEAN.construction: unitRMS(raw arithmetic mean of the exact [8,2048] sequence-adapter-induced L3_24 update matrix in the frozen reference order)

action_space.structured_axes.duplicate_rule: |cos(A_i,A_j)| < 0.98. The Gram-matched random bank controls for the preregistered A3/A4 correlation.
explicit_exclusions: the inadequate original d2 is not in the primary bank
the rejected shared-PC d4 is not in the primary bank
neither unstable centered adapter PC1 is used
A3 and A4 are not averaged into one shared direction
D2_OUTCOME_AXIS_V2 is diagnostic only and cannot modify this bank
action_space.structured_axes.mean_update_gate: A3/A4 must exactly equal unitRMS(float64 mean over the embedded exact float32 source matrix); no centering or PC; source-matrix file identity and ordered eight-task reference identity must verify
action_space.structured_axes.no_cross_locus_transport: every axis must exist or be reconstructed at exactly L3_24 in raw 2048-d residual coordinates. No L4 vector reused at L3, no layer-36 proxy, no unstable PC, no inadequate outcome axis, and no silent substitution.
action_space.structured_axes.selection: new v2 preregistered bank; four fixed source-derived geometries, not selected using O1 outcomes

action_space.writable_boundary.delta_broadcast_rule: Per branch, add delta only at the final non-padding prompt position at the L3_24 post-layer residual boundary. d has unit RMS over the hidden dimension; r is the pre-intervention per-position residual RMS; delta = sign * alpha * r * d. All other positions receive zero. Not repeated on generated tokens or at later loop/layer visits.
action_space.writable_boundary.status: INSTRUMENT CHOICE, not a claim that L3_24 is the optimal control locus. A negative result is scoped to this boundary and action family.

resolved_calibration_config.bank.stream_assignment_rule: stream(a,g) = (a + r_g) mod 8; a = 2*(direction_id-1) + (0 if sign=+1 else 1); r_g = task rank within its stratum in sealed manifest order, mod 8. Same schedule for the random bank. Enforced by gate G13.
resolved_calibration_config.decoding.stopping_rule: stop after the first parseable FINAL ANSWER commitment or at max_new_tokens; parser hash sealed
resolved_calibration_config.generator.hash_ordered_pool_offsets_cali: namespace=calibration; settings rules_2/rules_3/rules_4; first 32 accepted tasks per setting in deterministic nonce order
resolved_calibration_config.generator.task_id_hash_scheme: sha256(canonical UTF-8 JSON task specification, sorted keys, no whitespace)
resolved_calibration_config.transport.measurement_definition: rho = RMS(h_int[L4,47 boundary after model.norm, final non-padding prompt position] - h_base[same]) / RMS(delta_in). The state is taken from OuroModel per_loop_hidden_states[3], not from a differently numbered decoder-module hook. Scale-free ratio: does not conflate residual magnitude with alpha. Measured before any stochastic decoding.
resolved_calibration_config.transport.norm_convention: RMS over the 2048 hidden coordinates at the frozen measurement locus
